title: Tunisian Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired fish stew cooked in a traditional earthenware dish called a tagine. This recipe combines the rich flavors of Tunisian spices with the delicate taste of fish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of the tagine over medium heat.
Add the Tunisian Spice Blend and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the fish and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish stock, almonds, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, cover the tagine, and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
